summary: A self-hosted Go web app to view and edit Things 3 tasks in Things Cloud. It runs the reverse-engineered things-cli (arthursoares/things-cloud-sdk v0.6.0 plus a local patch) as a child process, builds its model from the CLI state cache, keeps the model in memory, and serves a dependency-free static frontend. Built for one owner; Basic Auth for LAN use, WebAuthn passkeys for internet access behind a TLS proxy.

entry_points.description: Server entry point: logging, passkey subcommands (passkey-setup, passkey-list, passkey-remove), HOST:PORT (default 127.0.0.1:4173), validateSecurityConfig, routes, warm-up sync, appHandler middleware chain.
Single-page UI: lists, sidebar with areas and projects, search, quick add, editor, Connect Things Cloud panel.

components.name: http-server
components.role: Route mux, apiHandler (status, login, logout, sync, complete, create), staticHandler, in-memory Things account.

components.name: cli-adapter
components.role: Finds things-cli and runs it with exec.Command (argv, no shell); the account goes through child environment variables; batch operations as JSON on stdin.

components.name: sync-model
components.role: Runs things-cli list and things-cli today, reads the cache, applies Things' list rules, the visible filter, the logbook rule and Today from the CLI, and sorts like Things.

components.name: model-cache
components.role: Keeps the last model in memory; background refresh after 30 s; ?fresh=1 waits for a sync after the last write; one sync at a time; copy-on-write patches after writes.

components.name: writes
components.role: Write endpoints through things-cli batch, edit, complete, create-tag, create-area; one write at a time (writeMu); retries only when nothing was written; APP_READ_ONLY via writePaths.

components.name: archive
components.role: GET /api/logbook and /api/trash from the cache file; 300 entries by default.

components.name: security-middleware
components.role: validateSecurityConfig, Basic Auth with lockout, httpsOnly, securityHeaders (CSP, HSTS behind HTTPS proxies), sameOriginGuard (POST, same origin, JSON, 64 KiB), ID and option-injection checks, server timeouts, appHandler.

components.name: passkeys
components.role: WebAuthn relying party per origin, /auth/* endpoints, /login, __Host-things_session cookie, setup codes, passkey CLI subcommands.

components.name: logging-and-compression
components.role: key=value logs on stderr with the account redacted, failed-request logging, /api/client-error; gzip for text and JSON.

components.name: frontend
components.role: Vanilla JS, no build step. Things-like lists, sidebar, editor, selection, keyboard shortcuts after Things for Mac with a cheat sheet (public/shortcuts.js), drag and drop, touch long press, optimistic updates; remembers the last list and the appearance (public/theme.js: System, Light, Dark) in localStorage.

interfaces.auth: APP_AUTH=basic (default): Basic Auth when APP_PASSWORD is set, required off loopback. APP_AUTH=passkey: WebAuthn session cookie required for everything except /login, /auth/* and login assets.

codes.401: No Things account signed in, no passkey session, or Basic Auth missing.
codes.403: Read-only instance, server-managed login/logout, same-origin guard, static traversal, unknown passkey origin, wrong setup code.
codes.405: Method other than GET, HEAD or POST.
codes.409: The cached model no longer has a referenced item; refresh.
codes.502: things-cli failed or printed non-JSON output.

configuration.name: HOST
configuration.description: Listen address. Docker sets 0.0.0.0 inside the container.

configuration.name: APP_USERNAME
configuration.description: Basic Auth user; WebAuthn user name in passkey mode.

configuration.name: APP_PASSWORD
configuration.description: Enables Basic Auth; required (>= 16 characters) off loopback in basic mode; ignored in passkey mode. Do not commit real values.

configuration.name: APP_PUBLIC_ORIGINS
configuration.description: Extra origins for the same-origin guard; passkey origins when APP_PASSKEY_ORIGINS is unset.

configuration.name: APP_PASSKEY_ORIGINS
configuration.description: Passkey origins (also APP_PASSKEY_ORIGIN); https, or http://localhost.

configuration.name: APP_READ_ONLY
configuration.description: 1, true or yes rejects all write endpoints with 403.

configuration.name: THINGS_PASSWORD
configuration.description: Things Cloud password. Fallbacks THINGS_TOKEN, THINGS_CLOUD_PASSWORD. Do not commit real values.

configuration.name: DATA_DIR
configuration.description: Directory for the CLI cache, passkeys.json and passkey-setup.json.

configuration.name: THINGS_CLI_CACHE
configuration.description: Path of the CLI state cache. Sensitive.

configuration.name: THINGS_CLOUD_CLI
configuration.description: Explicit path of the things-cli binary.

configuration.name: TZ
configuration.description: Decides which day is today for the app and things-cli.

dependencies.notes: One direct Go dependency (passkeys). Node tooling is test-only.

persistence.sensitivity: high (task metadata of the whole account)

persistence.stored_in: process memory (from env or browser sign-in)
localStorage key things-view (last opened list); passkey session cookie __Host-things_session; no credentials

security.trust_boundary: Browser (owner) -> TLS proxy -> Go server (account in memory) -> things-cli -> Things Cloud.
controls: Refuses to start off loopback in basic mode without APP_PASSWORD >= 16 characters
Basic Auth with constant-time compare and per-client plus global lockout
Passkey mode: WebAuthn per origin, user verification, __Host- session cookie, one-time setup codes
HTTPS redirect via X-Forwarded-Proto; HSTS behind HTTPS proxies
Security headers including a strict CSP
Same-origin guard: POST only, same origin or APP_PUBLIC_ORIGINS, JSON only, 64 KiB bodies
exec.Command(argv); the account goes to the CLI through child environment variables
ID validation and rejection of values starting with --
Server timeouts; hardened container (read-only, no capabilities, limits)
filepath.Rel containment in the static handler
known_limitations: No official API; the account password is on the server
No TLS in the app; Basic Auth has no second factor
GET /api/sync exposes the full CLI path in source
backend.directCloud and nativeFallback in /api/status are constants; there is no reader without things-cli

commands.name: go-checks-in-container
commands.cmd: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src -w /src golang:1.26-alpine sh -c 'gofmt -l . ; go vet ./... && go test -count=1 ./...'

commands.name: playwright-install
commands.cmd: npm install && npx playwright install chromium

tests.name: playwright-e2e
tests.notes: API mocked in the browser; server on 127.0.0.1:4180 with credentials cleared.

tests.name: playwright-passkey
